evidence: Cic. Att. 13.30.2: negat … hodiē: crās māne putat (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: From hōc diē. With a time of day: hodiē māne, this morning; hodiē vesperī, this evening (see those).

phrases.latin: subitō nōbīs hodiē Alexandrīnae nāvēs appāruērunt
phrases.english: suddenly today the ships from Alexandria came into sight

phrases.latin: sed properā, nec tē ventūrās differ in hōrās; quī nōn est hodiē, crās minus aptus erit
phrases.english: but hurry, and don’t put yourself off to the hours to come: whoever isn’t ready today will be less so tomorrow
